caption: Figure 1: Overview AUTOSAR methodology Firstly the System Configuration Input has to be defined. This is a system design or architecture task. The software components and the hardware have to be selected, and overall system constraints have to be identified. AUTOSAR intends to ease the formal description of these initial system design decisions via the information exchange format and the use of templates. So defining the System Configuration Input means filling out or editing the appropriate templates. This addresses information of the following packages
